requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr: The Private Markets Investing and Lending (PMIL) group leverages the firm’s balance sheet to deliver a comprehensive suite of structured financing and risk management solutions across the private markets ecosystem. The Private Equity Capital Call (PECC) team specializes in innovative fund-level financing, providing capital call and subscription facilities secured by the uncalled capital commitments of a fund’s limited partners. As part of Goldman Sachs’ Capital Solutions Group (CSG), the PECC team is at the forefront of consolidating the firm’s expertise in financing, origination, structuring, and risk management.
